note: Lean proves the bound for a general radius `W` with constants kept abstract; the specialisation `w = c w_0` giving `C_{m,k,w_0}/c` is not stated, and non-primary `E` is covered because `F` is arbitrary.

theorem density_price (hn : m ≤ N) (h : C.Makes) (F : Config G (C.side N p) → ℂ)
    (L : GridLane C m N p) (hl : L.Works r) {W u c d b : ℝ}
    (he : (L.sites r).Radial (fun _ => W) u c d b) (hW : 0 < W) (hf : ∀ i, L.load i=e)
    (hq : ∀ i,L.uses i=(center C.S p hn 0).copy i F) :
    (center C.S p hn 0).rootTest (C.beta N p) F ≤
      Real.exp (((C.S.a m/C.S.a r)^4)*Vac.treasury C.path.levels r + (u+c+d*b)) / ((C.S.a r ^ e)*W) := by

proof_context.conclusion: The residual bound holds for any observable `F` and any admissible radius `W` of a lane, uniformly in `N ≥ m` and `p`.

lemma est (hN : m≤ N) (h : C.Makes) (F : C.book.Token)
    (L : Lane C.path (census (Site (C.side m p))) N p) (hh : L.Works r) (W u c d' b : ℝ)
    (he : (L.sites r).Radial (fun _ => W) u c d' b) (hW : 0<W) (hq : ∀ i, L.load i=F.1)
    (hx : ∀ i,L.uses i=(center C.S p hN 0).copy i (C.O N p F.2 0)) :
    (center C.S p hN 0).rootTest (C.beta N p) (C.O N p (d:=F.1) F.2 0) ≤ Real.exp (expPrice C m r F.1 W u c d' b) := by

proof_context.conclusion: The same bound for the centred copy in root form, with `expPrice`.
